title: Passive Voice: All Tenses Review
grammarTitle: Passive Voice — All Tenses in One Place
grammarNote: Пассивный залог = TO BE (в нужном времени) + PAST PARTICIPLE. Это правило одинаково для всех времён — меняется только форма TO BE. В этом уроке мы собираем все формы пассивного залога вместе и практикуем переключение между временами.

grammarTable.subject: Present Simple
grammarTable.example: "The data is processed daily." / "Trees are planted each spring."

grammarTable.subject: Present Cont.
grammarTable.example: "The river is being tested." / "New laws are being proposed."

grammarTable.subject: Past Simple
grammarTable.example: "The factory was shut down." / "They were fined."

grammarTable.subject: Past Cont.
grammarTable.example: "The water was being tested when the problem was found."

grammarTable.subject: Present Perfect
grammarTable.example: "The population has been reduced." / "Laws have been strengthened."

grammarTable.subject: Past Perfect
grammarTable.example: "The river had been contaminated for years." / "It had been studied."

grammarTable.subject: Future (will)
grammarTable.example: "The results will be announced tomorrow." / "It will be cleaned up."

grammarTable.subject: Modal passive
grammarTable.example: "It must be reported." / "It should be protected." / "It can be done."

grammarExtra.title: The passive across tenses — key patterns

rows.example: "Water IS TESTED regularly." / "Species ARE PROTECTED by law."
"The river IS BEING CLEANED." / "New rules ARE BEING WRITTEN."
"The factory WAS SHUT DOWN." / "They WERE FINED last year."
"The area HAS BEEN PROTECTED since 2015." / "Laws HAVE BEEN PASSED."
"The study WILL BE COMPLETED by June." / "Results WILL BE PUBLISHED."
"Chemicals MUST BE DISPOSED of safely." / "Emissions SHOULD BE REDUCED."
"The factory WAS shut down." / "The forest IS protected."
"The factories WERE shut down." / "The forests ARE protected."
"The species HAS BEEN studied." / "The river HAS BEEN contaminated."
"The laws HAVE BEEN strengthened." / "They HAVE BEEN warned."

grammarExtra.title: BY + agent — when to include it

rows.form: Include BY when agent is important
rows.example: "The law was passed BY the parliament." (parliament = important info)

rows.form: Omit BY when agent is obvious
rows.example: "The road was repaired." (of course workers repaired it — no need to say "by workers")

rows.form: Omit BY when agent is unknown
rows.example: "The chemicals were released." (we don't know exactly who)
"The sample was collected and analysed." (standard — no "by scientists" needed)
"Carbon dioxide is released into the atmosphere." / "Species are protected by law."
"The Aral Sea is still being studied." / "New species are being discovered."
"Sea levels have been rising." / "Emissions have been reduced."
"New reserves will be established." / "Emissions will be limited by 2030."

grammarTip:
Passive Voice — все времена:

Пресент Симпл: is/are + pp
"Water IS tested regularly."

Презент Прогрессив: is/are being + pp
"The river IS BEING cleaned."

Прошедшее (Past Simple): was/were + pp
"The factory WAS shut down."

PresentПерфект: has/have been + pp
"The law HAS BEEN strengthened."

Паст Перфект: had been + pp
"It HAD BEEN contaminated for years."

Будущее: will be + pp
"Results WILL BE published."

Модальные: modal + be + pp
"Emissions MUST BE reduced."

💡 Правило одно для всех: TO BE (в нужном времени) + PAST PARTICIPLE

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct Present Simple Passive.
exercises.text: The water samples ___ every week to check for contamination.
exercises.hint: "samples" = plural → ARE. Present Simple Passive: "The samples ARE TESTED every week." ✅

exercises.text: "New environmental laws ___ (write) by the government right now."
exercises.hint: Present Continuous Passive: are/is + being + pp. "ARE BEING WRITTEN." ✅ (laws = plural → are)

exercises.text: The illegal factory ___ last year after years of investigation.
exercises.hint: "last year" = specific past time → Past Simple Passive. "WAS SHUT DOWN." ✅

exercises.text: "Several new national parks ___ (establish) in Kazakhstan recently."
exercises.hint: Recent change up to now → Present Perfect Passive. "HAVE BEEN ESTABLISHED." ✅ (parks = plural → have)

exercises.text: The cleanup of the river ___ by 2030 according to the government plan.
exercises.hint: "by 2030" = future → WILL BE COMPLETED. Future Simple Passive. ✅

exercises.text: Toxic waste ___ disposed of safely — it's required by law.
exercises.hint: Obligation + passive → modal + be + pp. "MUST BE disposed of safely." ✅

exercises.text: "The river ___ (contaminate) for years before the factory was discovered."
exercises.hint: Earlier past action → Past Perfect Passive. "HAD BEEN CONTAMINATED." ✅

exercises.text: "Right now, the riverbed ___ by environmental scientists."
exercises.hint: "Right now" = Present Continuous Passive. "IS BEING STUDIED." ✅

opts: "The park has been protected for fifty years."
exercises.correct: "The park has been protected for fifty years."
exercises.hint: "The park HAS BEEN PROTECTED for fifty years." ✅ — Present Perfect Passive. Others: "was" ≠ plural, "study" ≠ "studied", "will being" → "will be."
Active Present Continuous → Passive Present Continuous. "The glacier IS BEING STUDIED." ✅

exercises.instruction: Identify the tense of the passive.
exercises.text: "The law had already been passed before the pollution was discovered."
exercises.hint: "had been passed" = Past Perfect Passive (had + been + past participle). ✅ Earlier past action.

exercises.text: "Carbon emissions ___ significantly by 2035 to meet climate targets."
exercises.hint: Modal passive: modal + BE + past participle. "MUST BE REDUCED." ✅

questions.text: All passive forms follow the structure:
questions.hint: Passive = TO BE (in the right tense) + PAST PARTICIPLE. ✅
"is tested" = is + pp = Present Simple Passive. ✅
"is being cleaned" = is + being + pp = Present Continuous Passive. ✅ Action ongoing now.

questions.text: "The factory ___ (shut down) last year." (Past Simple Passive)
questions.hint: "last year" = past → WAS SHUT DOWN. Past Simple Passive. ✅
"have been strengthened" = have + been + pp = Present Perfect Passive. ✅

questions.text: "It ___ (contaminate) for years before anyone noticed." (Past Perfect Passive)
questions.hint: Earlier past → Past Perfect Passive: "HAD BEEN CONTAMINATED." ✅

questions.text: "The results WILL BE published next week." — Form:
questions.hint: "will be published" = will + be + pp = Future Simple Passive. ✅
"must be reduced" = modal (must) + be + past participle. ✅

questions.text: "The data WAS BEING COLLECTED when the error was found." — Tense:
questions.hint: "was being collected" = was + being + pp = Past Continuous Passive. ✅ Ongoing action in past.

questions.text: "Trees ARE planted every autumn." — This is:
questions.hint: "ARE planted" = are + pp = Present Simple Passive. ✅ Routine action in general.

questions.text: "Right now, the pollution levels ___ (monitor) by our team."
questions.hint: Ongoing now → Present Continuous Passive. "ARE BEING MONITORED." ✅

questions.text: "Several national parks ___ in Kazakhstan last decade." (establish)
questions.hint: "last decade" = specific past → WERE ESTABLISHED. Past Simple Passive. ✅

opts: The agent is obvious or unknown
The agent is important or surprising
questions.correct: The agent is important or surprising
questions.hint: Include BY + agent when the information is worth emphasising. Omit when obvious or unknown. ✅

questions.text: "The species should be protected." — "Should be protected" is:
questions.hint: "should be protected" = should (recommendation) + be + pp = Modal Passive. ✅
Future Passive: will + be + pp. "WILL BE COMPLETED by 2030." ✅

questions.text: Which is the CORRECT Present Perfect Passive?
questions.hint: "The law HAS BEEN PASSED." = has + been + pp = Present Perfect Passive. ✅
